mapper.select: select id, rule_code, rule_name, metric_key, operator_type, threshold_value, effect_type, score_value, risk_tag, reason_template, enabled, sort_order from risk_scoring_rule where enabled = 1 order by sort_order, id

select count(*) from risk_scoring_rule
where rule_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or rule_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or metric_key like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(risk_tag, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')

select id, rule_code, rule_name, metric_key, operator_type, threshold_value, effect_type, score_value, risk_tag, reason_template, enabled, sort_order, created_at, updated_at from risk_scoring_rule where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into risk_scoring_rule (rule_code, rule_name, metric_key, operator_type, threshold_value, effect_type, score_value, risk_tag, reason_template, enabled, sort_order) values (#{rule_code}, #{rule_name}, #{metric_key}, #{operator_type}, #{threshold_value}, #{effect_type}, #{score_value}, #{risk_tag}, #{reason_template}, #{enabled}, #{sort_order})
